assumptions: Upstream identity, frame hierarchy and camera intent remain authoritative outside the renderer.
limitations: This provider transports presentation coordinates only; it cannot create canonical positions, scientific truth, simulation state, identity, history or camera authority.

fidelity.validity: Hierarchical presentation-space transport with camera-relative precision and explicit frame boundaries.
fidelity.resolution: Float64 active/adjacent-frame CPU coordinates with Float32 high/low GPU projection when needed.
fidelity.uncertainty: Precision is bounded by the supplied upstream frame transform and does not improve source-model accuracy.

assumptions: Entity identity and provenance are supplied by upstream authorities and are preserved byte-for-semantic-byte by packet construction.
limitations: RenderPacket and RenderScene are GPU-neutral presentation contracts; they cannot promote provenance, mutate simulation state, or establish cross-GPU pixel identity.

fidelity.validity: Deterministic semantic packet composition independent of GPU backend and packet input order.
fidelity.resolution: Bounded scene packets with explicit geometry, material, picking and disposable-resource claims.
fidelity.uncertainty: Backend rasterization may vary across compliant GPUs while semantic packet identity remains deterministic.
